figure/img chrome for a standalone image (inline-flex column, centred, padding 5px, border 1px #e6e6e6, radius 3px)
the archived ActivityDetail.vue :deep() rules applied page-wide (h1/h2/h3 margins, p, ul/ol, blockquote)
hero h1: leading-tight is inert in Tailwind 3 (the responsive text-* block carries its own line length) but wins in Tailwind 4 through --tw-leading
description block: md:text-base line-height 24px vs leading-relaxed 26px
